sources.title: AminVilan/ppo-LunarLander-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🚀 PPO Agent playing for LunarLander-v3 The Github repository contains a trained Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent for the classic control task LunarLander-v3 from Gymnasium. The model is implemented and trained using the Stable-Baselines3 library.

sources.snippet: ppo-LunarLander-v3 is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find ppo-LunarLander-v3 on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of ppo-LunarLander-v3 install, users can directly use ppo-LunarLander-v3 installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.

sources.title: GitHub - jaredlcs/lunarlander-ppo
sources.snippet: This project trains an AI agent to land a lunar module safely using PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization), a state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithm. The agent learns by trial and error, controlling thrusters to achieve soft landings.
